atlas.grid_proof: type2 dispatch retains default16 at499216; quad takes integer grid count then reciprocal UV

material.name: particle_blend
material.native: projected rotated four-vertex quads; diffuse + secondary packed RGB
material.host: unlit alpha mix, depth test on, depth write off; texture*diffuse+secondary; gamma supplied by caller

host_contract.clock: one update per external particle-manager pass; type2 dispatch scale is source1.0, not frame delta
host_contract.transform: caller maps native XYZ to emitter-local Godot XYZ
host_contract.size: caller supplies local quad half extents for native size=1
host_contract.gates: caller supplies emitting/visibility; no world fog or owner lookup

Object-to-emitter transform, wall rotation, depth packing and native projection must be supplied by host.
Class tail flags 0,0,-1 and distance/owner shutdown semantics are not fully mapped.
Private seeded RNG follows EXE recurrence but cannot reproduce shared global random interleaving.
